Essential Ocean Variable (EOV) taxonomic seeds

Source: R/eov.R
obis_eov_seeds.Rd

The root WoRMS AphiaIDs defining each biology & ecosystems EOV, per the IOOS Marine Life Data Network. Expand them to occurrences with obis_eov_sql(), or to their descendant taxa with obis_taxon_children().

Usage

obis_eov_seeds(eov = NULL)

Arguments

eov

optional EOV name(s) to restrict to; default all. One or more of "fish", "hardCorals", "mangroves", "marineMammals", "seabirds", "seagrasses", "seaTurtles".

Value

data frame with one row per seed taxon: eov, label, aphiaid, taxon.

Examples

head(obis_eov_seeds())
#>          eov       label aphiaid          taxon
#> 1       fish        Fish    1829        Agnatha
#> 2       fish        Fish 1517375 Chondrichthyes
#> 3       fish        Fish  152352   Osteichthyes
#> 4 hardCorals Hard corals    1363   Scleractinia
#> 5  mangroves   Mangroves  235048   Combretaceae
#> 6  mangroves   Mangroves  235033      Avicennia
obis_eov_seeds("seaTurtles")
#>          eov       label aphiaid        taxon
#> 1 seaTurtles Sea turtles  987094 Chelonioidea
